description: This file defines in-memory transport components for testing within the Orleans framework, including connection factories, listeners, and a connection hub, to simulate communication channels without real network usage.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportListener
classes.description: Implements an in-memory connection listener for testing, managing connection acceptance via channels and integrating with the connection hub.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportConnectionHub
classes.description: Singleton managing registration and retrieval of in-memory connection listeners based on endpoints.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportConnectionFactory
classes.description: Creates in-memory connections to registered listeners, facilitating simulated network connections.

methods.name: UseInMemoryConnectionTransport
methods.description: Extension methods to add in-memory transport support to Silo and Client builders.

methods.name: CreateInMemoryConnectionFactory
methods.description: Factory method creating a connection factory with specified hub.

methods.name: CreateInMemoryConnectionListenerFactory
methods.description: Factory method creating a connection listener factory with specified hub.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Establishes a simulated connection to the listener.

methods.name: BindAsync
methods.description: Binds the listener to an endpoint and registers it with the hub.

methods.name: UnbindAsync
methods.description: Unbinds and terminates the listener, completing all pending acceptances.

methods.name: RegisterConnectionListenerFactory
methods.description: Adds a listener to the hub for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: GetConnectionListenerFactory
methods.description: Retrieves a registered listener for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Establishes a simulated in-memory connection to a specified endpoint.
